china_race_dynamics.text:
I am not ignorant to the competition with China on AI, but there is simply no realistic risk that we do too much when it comes to regulating AI. I mean, have you seen Congress? 

The risk is clearly that we do too little -- and that risk is too great to bear.

deepseek.reason: The speaker acknowledges competition with China but argues the greater risk is regulating AI too little.
deepseek.confidence_reason: The statement explicitly prioritizes regulation despite competition, without clearly endorsing or rejecting competition as a policy priority.
